hook: A building the shape of a Type C refugee shack, moved here from 333 Peralta Avenue in 1948.

historic_survey.finding: Not eligible for the National Register or the California Register
historic_survey.note: The building matches a Type C earthquake relief shack in scale, massing and form, but later alterations removed the board-and-batten siding, the galvanized metal chimney and the redwood shingle roof, leaving too little to carry the association.

historical_record.description: The house was moved onto this lot from 333 Peralta Avenue, near the site of the Precita Park refugee camp.
